word_order: SVO — samples repeatedly show Subject before Verb before Object (e.g. 'Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device').
register: Formal informational/encyclopedic prose (written, factual descriptions and news-like summaries).
notes_for_prompt_writer: Prefer to delay segmentation across initial subordinating words (although, because, if, while, when, once) until their clause core (verb + object) appears. Splits at coordinating conjunctions (and, but) that introduce independent clauses are usually safe; avoid splitting right after prepositions, determiners, possessives, numerals or percent expressions. Treat multiword discourse markers (e.g., "of course", "in the end", "because of") as single units and keep them attached to the following material.
